messages:
sam: Heads up - acme-prod reporting embeddings throughput drop ~60% since 04:10 UTC. Tokens/sec flat, vectors/sec tanked. Customer says nothing changed client-side.

marta: thanks. any client errors? dim mismatch? auth? billing?

sam: no 4xx/5xx in their traces. Sample request headers & payload size look normal. They sent 1536-d vectors as usual.

qi-ml-oncall: grabbing metrics now. Do you have request ids or a timeslice?

sam: request ids: req=acme-req-3342, acme-req-3349. Span: 04:09:58 - 04:11:12 UTC.

qi-ml-oncall: quick check - our tokens/series (text gen) steady; embeddings worker gpu_slot_waiters and queue_depth for shard-gpu-5 jumped at 04:09:45. kvcache_lock waits spike too.

marta: could be a KV cache hit pattern change causing serialized access + tiny batches. If batches fall to size 1 we lose throughput. Any rollout around that time?

raj-infra: deploy-bot shows a config rollout at 04:08:50: batching-window-ms shortened from 15ms -> 3ms for the per-tenant optimizer. This aligns.

sam: aha. customer traffic is bursty; shorter window would create more small batches. But why kvcache locks?

qi-ml-oncall: when batch size shrinks, we do more concurrent KV cache priming per request which increases kvcache_lock contention. On GPUs that can cause slot waiters because tasks block waiting for cache I/O.

marta: suggestions: revert batching-window change for tenant optimizer, and temporarily route acme to standby model-quantized-128 variant (less kvcache pressure) while we investigate.

sam: initiating rollback for the config changes now. @raj-infra can you also route acme to standby?

raj-infra: routing rule applied (route-id r-782). ACME now hitting model variant "embed-small-kv-friendly".

deploy-bot: Rollback started: config/optimizer-window reverted to 15ms. Rollout id rld-2026-0412-07.

qi-ml-oncall: metrics update: gpu_slot_waiters normalized within 90s, queue_depth dropped ~70%, vectors/sec for ACME back to ~95% of baseline. kvcache_lock waits reduced.

sam: customer confirms improvement on call. Thank you.

marta: next steps: add pre-deploy gating for per-tenant batching-window changes (simulate spikes), and add a circuit to prevent per-tenant windows <8ms unless traffic profile validated.

qi-ml-oncall: I'll open a follow-up runbook item: reproduce locally with bursty trace generator, record kvcache lock metrics, and add a regression test for batching-window <8ms.

raj-infra: also adding a transient metric alert: if vectors/sec/tokens/sec ratio drops >30% for any tenant for >2min, auto-route to fallback variant and notify oncall.

sam: good. I've marked this resolved for now. Will keep thread open for runbook PR. :thumbsup:

marta: assign to qi for runbook + PR. Thanks everyone.

qi-ml-oncall: on it, creating PR #4721 with repro harness and test cases.

sam: closing after PR lands.
